```{r}

SIG_THRESHOLD  <- 0.05
DPSI_THRESHOLD <- 0.1
EVENT_TYPES    <- c("SE", "RI", "MXE", "A5SS", "A3SS")

calc_mean_counts <- function(count_str) {
  if(all(is.na(count_str))) return(NA)
  sapply(strsplit(as.character(count_str), ","), function(x) {
    mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------

load_rmats_master_table <- function(dir_path, invert_dpsi = TRUE) {

  load_one_event_type <- function(ev) {   
    f <- file.path(dir_path, paste0(ev, ".MATS.JC.txt"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) {
      warning(sprintf("Missing file: %s - kihagyva.", f))
      return(NULL)
    }

    df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA", "NaN", "null"))
    coord_cols <- grep("Start_0base$|End$|ES$|EE$", names(df), value = TRUE)

    df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        EventType = ev,
        p_val     = as.numeric(PValue),
        p_val_adj = as.numeric(FDR),
        dPSI      = if (invert_dpsi) -as.numeric(IncLevelDifference) else as.numeric(IncLevelDifference),
        Position  = apply(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(coord_cols)), 1, paste, collapse = "-"),
        Event_ID  = paste(EventType, chr, strand, Position, sep = "_"),
        
        #  Means calc
        mean_IJC_1 = calc_mean_counts(IJC_SAMPLE_1),
        mean_SJC_1 = calc_mean_counts(SJC_SAMPLE_1),
        mean_IJC_2 = calc_mean_counts(IJC_SAMPLE_2),
        mean_SJC_2 = calc_mean_counts(SJC_SAMPLE_2)
      ) %>%
      # IJC+SJC mean at least be 30
      dplyr::filter((mean_IJC_1 + mean_SJC_1 >= 30) | (mean_IJC_2 + mean_SJC_2 >= 30)) %>%
      
      dplyr::rename(Chr = chr, Strand_Info = strand, Gene_ID = GeneID, Gene_Name = geneSymbol) %>%
      dplyr::select(Event_ID, EventType, Chr, Position, Strand_Info, Gene_ID, Gene_Name,
                     p_val, p_val_adj, dPSI)
  }

  combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(EVENT_TYPES, load_one_event_type))

  if (nrow(combined) == 0 || !"p_val_adj" %in% names(combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Missing rMATS file here: %s", dir_path))
  }

  n_dup <- sum(duplicated(combined$Event_ID))
  if (n_dup > 0) {
    warning(sprintf("%d duplicated Event_ID in %s directory.", n_dup, dir_path))
  }

  combined %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_val_adj)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(dPSI)))
}

rmats_base_dir <- "/home/akos/Desktop/lab/TDK/rmats"
comparisons    <- c("CTR_vs_TIS", "TIS_vs_REPOP", "CTR_vs_REPOP")

load_all_comparisons <- function(cell_line) {
  setNames(
    lapply(comparisons, function(cmp) {
      load_rmats_master_table(file.path(rmats_base_dir, cell_line, cmp, "output"))
    }),
    comparisons
  )
}

mcf7_tables <- load_all_comparisons("mcf7")
t47d_tables <- load_all_comparisons("t47d")

get_sig_ids <- function(master_data) {
  master_data %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
    pull(Event_ID)
}

sig_ids_mcf7 <- lapply(mcf7_tables, get_sig_ids)
sig_ids_t47d <- lapply(t47d_tables, get_sig_ids)
```

```{r}


mcf7_sig_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(mcf7_tables, function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD)
}))

mcf7_sig_unique <- mcf7_sig_all %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Event_ID, EventType)

mcf7_event_summary <- mcf7_sig_unique %>%
  dplyr::group_by(EventType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Event_Count = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = EventType, values_from = Event_Count, values_fill = 0)


expected_events <- c("SE", "RI", "MXE", "A3SS", "A5SS")
present_events <- intersect(expected_events, names(mcf7_event_summary))
mcf7_event_summary <- mcf7_event_summary %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(present_events))

total_events <- sum(mcf7_event_summary)

DT::datatable(
  mcf7_event_summary,
  caption = paste0("Number of significant unique splicing events by type (MCF7) - Total: ", total_events),
  options = list(
    dom = 'Brtip',
    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
    scrollX = TRUE
  ),
  extensions = "Buttons",
  class = 'compact cell-border stripe hover',
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}

make_sig_table_full <- function(master_data, label) {
  master_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
    dplyr::select(Event_ID, EventType, Gene_Name, Position, p_val_adj, dPSI) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(comparison = label)
}

mcf7_sig_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(mcf7_tables), function(cmp) {
  make_sig_table_full(mcf7_tables[[cmp]], cmp)
}))

t47d_sig_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(t47d_tables), function(cmp) {
  make_sig_table_full(t47d_tables[[cmp]], cmp)
}))

dedup_sig_table <- function(sig_all, suffix) {
  sig_all %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Event_ID, EventType, Gene_Name, Position) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      !!paste0("comparisons_", suffix) := paste(sort(unique(comparison)), collapse = ", "),
      !!paste0("dPSI_", suffix)        := dPSI[which.min(p_val_adj)],
      !!paste0("p_val_adj_", suffix)   := min(p_val_adj),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

mcf7_sig_dedup <- dedup_sig_table(mcf7_sig_all, "MCF7")
t47d_sig_dedup <- dedup_sig_table(t47d_sig_all, "T47D")

overlap_genes <- dplyr::inner_join(
  mcf7_sig_dedup,
  t47d_sig_dedup %>% dplyr::select(Event_ID, comparisons_T47D, dPSI_T47D, p_val_adj_T47D),
  by = "Event_ID"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dPSI_MCF7      = round(dPSI_MCF7, 3),
    dPSI_T47D      = round(dPSI_T47D, 3),
    p_val_adj_MCF7 = signif(p_val_adj_MCF7, 3),
    p_val_adj_T47D = signif(p_val_adj_T47D, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name, Event_ID)

datatable(
  overlap_genes,
  caption = "Significant splicing events and their genes in both cell lines",
  extensions = c("FixedColumns", "Buttons"),
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('excel', 'pdf', 'csv'),
    scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 4, fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 3)
  ),
  class = 'compact cell-border stripe hover',
  rownames = FALSE
) %>%
  formatStyle(
    c('dPSI_MCF7', 'dPSI_T47D'),
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(-DPSI_THRESHOLD, DPSI_THRESHOLD), c('#FADBD8', 'white', '#D1F2EB'))
  )
  
```

```{r venn-final, fig.width=18, fig.height=6.5}
venn_fill <- scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#4292C6")

venn_theme <- theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20,
                             margin = margin(b = 15)),
  plot.margin = margin(15, 45, 15, 45)

sig_mcf7_named <- setNames(sig_ids_mcf7, c("CTR vs TIS", "TIS vs REPOP", "CTR vs REPOP"))
sig_t47d_named <- setNames(sig_ids_t47d, c("CTR vs TIS", "TIS vs REPOP", "CTR vs REPOP"))

make_venn_panel <- function(sets, title) {
  ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0, set_size = 6, label_size = 5.5,
                edge_size = 0.7) +
    venn_fill + venn_clip + labs(title = title) + venn_theme
}

p_mcf7_all  <- make_venn_panel(sig_mcf7_named, "MCF7\nSplicing events")
p_t47d_all  <- make_venn_panel(sig_t47d_named, "T47D\nSplicing events")
```

```{r fig.width=18, fig.height=6.5}
sig_mcf7_named <- setNames(sig_ids_mcf7, c("CTR vs TIS", "TIS vs REPOP", "CTR vs REPOP"))

make_euler_panel <- function(sets, title_text) {
  fit <- euler(sets)
  
  p <- plot(fit,
            quantities = list(cex = 0.95),
            labels = list(cex = 0.95),
            edges = list(lwd = 1.2),
            fills = list(fill = c("#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6"), alpha = 0.7),
            padding = grid::unit(2, "lines") 
  )
  wrap_elements(p) +
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18, 
                                lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 25, 10, 25) 
    )
}

p_mcf7_all  <- make_euler_panel(sig_mcf7_named, "MCF7\nSplicing events")
p_t47d_all  <- make_euler_panel(sig_t47d_named, "T47D\nSplicing events")

p_mcf7_t47d <- make_euler_panel(
  list(MCF7 = unique(unlist(sig_ids_mcf7)),
       T47D = unique(unlist(sig_ids_t47d))),
  "MCF7 vs T47D\nShared TIS and REPOP splicing events"
) 

fig_euler_all <- (p_mcf7_all | p_t47d_all | p_mcf7_t47d) +
```

```{r}
venn_fill <- scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#4292C6")

venn_theme <- theme_void() + theme(
  legend.position = "none", 
  plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18,
                             margin = margin(b = 15)),
  plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
)

get_venn_bbox <- function(sets) {
  edge <- venn_setedge(process_data(Venn(sets)))
  g <- edge[["geometry"]]
  if (!is.null(g)) {
    bb <- sf::st_bbox(g)
    list(xmin = bb[["xmin"]], xmax = bb[["xmax"]],
         ymin = bb[["ymin"]], ymax = bb[["ymax"]])
  } else {
    list(xmin = min(edge$X), xmax = max(edge$X),
         ymin = min(edge$Y), ymax = max(edge$Y))
  }
}

make_venn_outside <- function(sets, title, label_size = 5.5,
                              set_label_size = 6.5, gap = 0.1, pad = 0.4) {

  bb  <- get_venn_bbox(sets)
  lab <- venn_setlabel(process_data(Venn(sets)))
  
  lab <- lab[order(-lab$Y), ]

  w <- bb$xmax - bb$xmin
  h <- bb$ymax - bb$ymin
  
  xmid <- (bb$xmin + bb$xmax) / 2
  ymid <- (bb$ymin + bb$ymax) / 2
  
  max_dist_x <- (w / 2) + (w * pad)
  max_dist_y <- (h / 2) + (h * 0.15)

  suppressMessages(
    ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0, set_size = 0, 
                  label_size = label_size, edge_size = 0.8) +
      venn_fill +
      annotate("text", x = bb$xmin - (w * gap), y = lab$Y[1],
               label = lab$name[1], size = set_label_size, hjust = 1) +
      annotate("text", x = bb$xmin - (w * gap), y = lab$Y[2],
               label = lab$name[2], size = set_label_size, hjust = 1) +
      coord_sf(xlim = c(xmid - max_dist_x, xmid + max_dist_x),
               ylim = c(ymid - max_dist_y, ymid + max_dist_y),
               expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
      labs(title = title) +
      venn_theme
  )
}

p_mcf7_ctrtis_tisrepop <- make_venn_outside(
  sets  = list("CTR vs TIS"   = sig_ids_mcf7[["CTR_vs_TIS"]],
               "TIS vs REPOP" = sig_ids_mcf7[["TIS_vs_REPOP"]]),
  title = "MCF7\nShared TIS and REPOP splicing events"
)

print(p_mcf7_ctrtis_tisrepop)

ggsave("venn_mcf7_ctrtis_tisrepop.png", p_mcf7_ctrtis_tisrepop,
       width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r out.width="100%"}
collect_sig <- function(tables) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(tables), function(cmp) {
    tables[[cmp]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
      dplyr::select(Event_ID, Gene_Name, Position, p_val_adj, dPSI) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(comparison = cmp)
  }))
}

mcf7_sig_all <- collect_sig(mcf7_tables)
t47d_sig_all <- collect_sig(t47d_tables)

overlap_same_cond <- dplyr::inner_join(
  mcf7_sig_all %>%
    dplyr::rename(dPSI_MCF7 = dPSI, padj_MCF7 = p_val_adj),
  t47d_sig_all %>%
    dplyr::select(Event_ID, comparison,
                  dPSI_T47D = dPSI, padj_T47D = p_val_adj),
  by = c("Event_ID", "comparison")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dPSI_MCF7 = round(dPSI_MCF7, 3),
    dPSI_T47D = round(dPSI_T47D, 3),
    padj_MCF7 = signif(padj_MCF7, 3),
    padj_T47D = signif(padj_T47D, 3),
    same_direction = ifelse(sign(dPSI_MCF7) == sign(dPSI_T47D), "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(comparison, Gene_Name, Event_ID, Position,
                dPSI_MCF7, dPSI_T47D, same_direction, padj_MCF7, padj_T47D) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(comparison, Gene_Name, Event_ID)

print(dplyr::count(overlap_same_cond, comparison))

DT::datatable(
  overlap_same_cond,
  caption = paste0("Overlapping splicing events in MCF7 and T47D under the same condition (n = ",
                   nrow(overlap_same_cond), ", genes: ",
                   dplyr::n_distinct(overlap_same_cond$Gene_Name), ")"),
  extensions = c("Buttons"),
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    scrollX = FALSE,   
    autoWidth = TRUE,  
    pageLength = 15,
    search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE)
  ),

  class = "compact cell-border stripe hover", 
  rownames = FALSE
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    c("dPSI_MCF7", "dPSI_T47D"),
    backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(
      c(-DPSI_THRESHOLD, DPSI_THRESHOLD), c("#FADBD8", "white", "#D1F2EB")
    )
  ) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "same_direction",
    fontWeight = "bold",
    color = DT::styleEqual(c("yes", "no"), c("#005B41", "#C0392B"))
  ) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    c("Event_ID", "Position"),
    `word-break` = 'break-all'
  )
```

```{r}

collect_sig <- function(tables) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(tables), function(cmp) {
    tables[[cmp]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
      dplyr::select(Event_ID, Gene_Name, Position, p_val_adj, dPSI) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(comparison = cmp)
  }))
}

mcf7_sig_all <- collect_sig(mcf7_tables)
t47d_sig_all <- collect_sig(t47d_tables)

overlap_same_cond_dir <- dplyr::inner_join(
  mcf7_sig_all %>%
    dplyr::rename(dPSI_MCF7 = dPSI, padj_MCF7 = p_val_adj),
  t47d_sig_all %>%
    dplyr::select(Event_ID, comparison,
                  dPSI_T47D = dPSI, padj_T47D = p_val_adj),
  by = c("Event_ID", "comparison")
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sign(dPSI_MCF7) == sign(dPSI_T47D)) %>%      # same direction
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = ifelse(dPSI_MCF7 > 0, "Up", "Down"),
    dPSI_MCF7 = round(dPSI_MCF7, 3),
    dPSI_T47D = round(dPSI_T47D, 3),
    padj_MCF7 = signif(padj_MCF7, 3),
    padj_T47D = signif(padj_T47D, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(comparison, direction, Gene_Name, Event_ID, Position,
                dPSI_MCF7, dPSI_T47D, padj_MCF7, padj_T47D) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(comparison, direction, Gene_Name, Event_ID)

print(dplyr::count(overlap_same_cond_dir, comparison, direction))

DT::datatable(
  overlap_same_cond_dir,
  caption = paste0("Overlapping splicing events in MCF7 and T47D under the same condition and direction (n = ",
                   nrow(overlap_same_cond_dir), ", genes: ",
                   dplyr::n_distinct(overlap_same_cond_dir$Gene_Name), ")"),
  extensions = c("Buttons", "FixedColumns"),
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    scrollX = TRUE,
    pageLength = 15,
    search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
    fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 3)
  ),
  class = "compact cell-border stripe hover",
  rownames = FALSE
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    c("dPSI_MCF7", "dPSI_T47D"),
    backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(
      c(-DPSI_THRESHOLD, DPSI_THRESHOLD), c("#FADBD8", "white", "#D1F2EB")
    )
  ) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "direction",
    fontWeight = "bold",
    color = DT::styleEqual(c("Up", "Down"), c("#005B41", "#C0392B"))
  )
```

```{r}


get_sig_events_with_type <- function(tables_list) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(tables_list, function(df) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
      dplyr::select(Event_ID, EventType)
  })) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Event_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

mcf7_events <- get_sig_events_with_type(mcf7_tables) %>%
  dplyr::count(EventType) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CellLine = "MCF7")

t47d_events <- get_sig_events_with_type(t47d_tables) %>%
  dplyr::count(EventType) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CellLine = "T47D")

plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(mcf7_events, t47d_events) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CellLine) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total = sum(n),
    Prop = n / Total
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(EventType = factor(EventType, levels = c("SE", "RI", "MXE", "A3SS", "A5SS")))

p_donut <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = 2, y = Prop, fill = EventType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ CellLine) +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "SE"   = "#4292C6", 
    "RI"   = "#EF3B2C", 
    "MXE"  = "#41AB5D", 
    "A3SS" = "#807DBA", 
    "A5SS" = "#F16913"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of significant splicing event types",
    fill = "Event types"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Prop > 0.01, scales::percent(Prop, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#222222")

print(p_donut)

ggsave("rmats_event_types_donut.png", p_donut, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
